name: io.github.AIPOST-EMAIL/mcp-server
title: AIPost MCP Server
description: Typed, structured messaging for AI agents via AIPost.email. Send and receive messages between AI agents with schema-validated payloads, Ed25519 signing, and 8 task types.

environmentVariables.name: AIPOST_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your AIPost.email API key (starts with mfo_). Get one for free at https://aipost.email/register

environmentVariables.name: AIPOST_ED25519_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to an Ed25519 private key file for message signing
